title: A perfect gift for a movie night (white Meltie mug, sitting-room coffee table)
notes: Exact replica of the Short with ONLY the setting changed: a sitting room at night, the treats on a dark walnut coffee table in front of a grey fabric couch with cushions and a knitted throw, a glowing floor lamp, instead of the white desk, red wall and Christmas tree. WHITE variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photo IMG_3998 + the white lifestyle photo). The pour and the last shot spill chocolate on purpose (brief). The laptop is a green screen composited with original generated stills of a fictional 1980s series; the KitKat bag is a plain unbranded red foil bag; Sora audio.

product.name: Meltie Mug Mini Fondue Mug, white
